_meta.description: BOTW recipe table. "table" is the game's CookData exactly in priority order; "dishes" groups the entries per result.
_meta.matching: See cooking-rules.md. Each slot must be filled by a DIFFERENT distinct ingredient (several copies of one ingredient fill one slot). Extra ingredients that fill no slot are allowed. The first matching entry in table order wins.
_meta.heartBonus: HB from the table, in quarter hearts, added after doubling.
sources: Pistonite/botw-recipe research/output/cookdata-recipes.yaml (decode of the game file Cooking/CookData; MIT)
Monster dish names cross-checked with savage13/cooking.rs src/cook_recipes.json (BSD-2-Clause)

dishes.name: Fairy Tonic
dishes.notes: Any cook containing a Fairy matches this first unless a higher entry wins. Effects are always removed; heal = 2 x raw hearts - 12 quarter hearts.

dishes.name: Rock-Hard Food
dishes.notes: Produced by ore/gems/wood (CookOre) with nothing that matches a higher entry. Heals 1 quarter heart; sells for 2.

dishes.name: Elixir
dishes.notes: Generic elixir result. Needs a critter (CookInsect) and a monster part (CookEnemy). If the critters give no single effect it turns into Dubious Food. The shown name depends on the effect (see the 11 elixir entries).

dishes.name: Dubious Food
dishes.notes: Failure result. Also produced when nothing in the table matches, or when an Elixir has no usable effect. Heals raw hearts (not doubled), at least 1 heart; sells for 2.
